description: Comprehensive anonymous utility hub — dependency-ordered slices collectively covering the complete product

slices.name: SEO Infrastructure and Public Shell
slices.description: Deploy robots.txt, sitemap, metadata system, canonical URLs, schema markup, and the public marketing shell. Foundation for all content and discoverability.
slices.verticalSpan: entry UI → SEO metadata → public shell → deployed verification
slices.testApproach: Unit tests for metadata generation, integration test for sitemap/robots, deployed verification via public URL

slices.name: Tool Directory and Public Shell Pages
slices.description: Build the complete tool directory, homepage, and all public landing pages. Every tool is discoverable from /tools.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool directory → individual tool pages → connection indicators → context transfer readiness
slices.testApproach: Deployed URL verification, tool reachability test, connection indicator check

slices.name: Formulation and Chemistry Calculator
slices.description: Implement the deterministic formulation engine, source-manifest boundary, synthetic fixtures, NaOH/KOH/mixed-alkali semantics, per-alkali purity, recipe-level superfat, three water modes, and production-off release control.
slices.verticalSpan: Formulation input → deterministic calculation → assumptions/warnings → versioned output → context ready for transfer
slices.testApproach: TDD from CALCULATION-SPEC §14 synthetic algebra fixtures; property invariants; unit round-trips; typed fail-closed manifest and production-flag tests

slices.name: Chemistry Verification Gate
slices.description: Complete the chemistry verification gate: deterministic specification, source manifest, independent review, hand/reference calculations, cross-calculator fixtures. Required before any chemistry feature becomes public.
slices.verticalSpan: Deterministic spec → source manifest → independent review → fixtures → public release gate
slices.testApproach: Independent fixture verification, domain owner review sign-off, cross-calculator comparison

slices.name: Sizing and Conversion Calculator
slices.description: Build sizing, unit conversion, recipe scaling, mold sizing, bar-count planning, and multi-mold allocation. Receives context from formulation via Recipe/Batch Context.
slices.verticalSpan: Formulation context → sizing input → deterministic output → context transfer → sizing ready for costing
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, boundary tests, context transfer tests, unit-conversion round-trip tests

slices.name: Costing and Pricing Calculator
slices.description: Build ingredient, packaging, labor, overhead, waste, and yield costing; markup and gross margin; retail/wholesale/channel scenarios; minimum viable price.
slices.verticalSpan: Sizing context → cost inputs → full batch cost → markup/margin → scenarios → context ready for markets
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, verified reference cases, markup vs gross margin distinction tests, missing-cost warning tests

slices.name: Markets and Sales Planning
slices.description: Build craft-fair break-even, product mix, stock/revenue/sell-through planning, target-profit, wholesale MOQ, and quote/price-sheet output.
slices.verticalSpan: Costing context → market inputs → break-even → stock targets → quote output → context ready for purchasing
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, break-even reference cases, event fee impact tests

slices.name: Production and Cure Planning
slices.description: Build production date planning, capacity back-planning, batch/lot records, cure tracking, Making Mode workflow, and printable records.
slices.verticalSpan: Formulation context → production planning → batch creation → Making Mode → cure tracking → printable records
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, Making Mode timer resume tests, batch state machine tests, cure observation tests

slices.name: Purchasing and Inventory Planning
slices.description: Build ingredient/packaging requirements, pack rounding, supplier comparison, requirements minus stock, event counts, anonymous local planning, and optional-account persistence.
slices.verticalSpan: Formulation context → requirements → pack rounding → supplier comparison → stock tracking → inventory depletion
slices.testApproach: Unit tests, pack rounding tests, requirements-minus-stock tests, supplier comparison tests

slices.name: Context Transfer and Share System
slices.description: Context transfer between calculators, share URLs with full recipe context, methodology pages. Cross-cutting capability CTX-001 enables F14 (Share URL Context Transfer) and F18 (Generic Context Transfer). Users share formulated plans without re-entry.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool output → context capture → version chain → context transfer → share URL → reload/decode
slices.testApproach: Context transfer integration tests, share URL encode/decode tests, version chain tests, reload tests

slices.name: Account and Cloud Persistence
slices.description: Optional account creation, cloud persistence for recipes/batches, cross-device sync. Account is NEVER required for core tools.
slices.verticalSpan: Account creation → cloud sync → full authenticated lifecycle → data persistence → cross-device sync
slices.testApproach: E2E test for full authenticated flow, sync tests, ownership verification tests, security tests

slices.name: Utility-Support System: Content, Guides, Examples
slices.description: Methodology pages, decision guides, factual comparisons, visual explanations. Content provides depth and SEO without gating core tools.
slices.verticalSpan: SEO shell → content page → embedded tool or worked calculation → download artifact → tool connection
slices.testApproach: Content quality validation, pageMetadata() verification, embedded tool functionality test

slices.name: Seller Pack Delivery
slices.description: Build one-time Seller Pack artifact delivery (costing workbook, market planner, batch/cure sheet, wholesale quote sheet, inventory count sheet). After value delivered, optional email exchange with explicit consent. BLOCKED-004: Requires payment infrastructure specification.
slices.verticalSpan: Tool result → Seller Pack request → explicit consent → artifact delivery → no subscription created
slices.testApproach: Integration test for artifact delivery, consent verification, no-subscription check
slices.note: DEFERRED (BLOCKER-004): Seller Pack delivery requires payment infrastructure specification. Acceptance rows present (MKT-DEFERRED-SELLER-PACK) but implementation blocked until payment integration is specified. Cannot start until SLICE-006 through SLICE-009 complete.

slices.name: E2E and Deployment Verification
slices.description: Comprehensive E2E testing, anonymous mobile/desktop verification, deployment checks, and full acceptance gate validation across all slices. Covers all 63 capability IDs and 9 core flows (F1, F7, F8, F10, F14, F15, F16, F17, F18).
slices.verticalSpan: All slices → anonymous E2E → deployed verification → acceptance gate → comprehensive release
slices.testApproach: Full E2E anonymous flow, deployed URL verification, calculation test suite, security verification

Gate_C.description: Stop implementation until user approves scope/behavior and every core flow has a high-boundary acceptance row
Gate_C.note: Isaac authorized implementation on 2026-09-09. External evidence remains a fail-closed release gate for affected public routes.

Gate_R.description: No slice starts when a required skill is missing, unloadable, unapplied, or unreceipted
Gate_R.note: All skills routed and receipted. See skill-receipts.json.

Gate_A.description: Only literal RELEASE_ACCEPTED permits completion claim
Gate_A.note: Awaiting RELEASE_ACCEPTED after build and verification. Deferred items (MKT-DEFERRED-SELLER-PACK) tracked as PENDING until demand evidence exists.
